column1: # boards.tsv — maps a physical Teensy (by USB serial number) to the mix-kit
# firmware it should run: a PlatformIO env (synth engine + RAM tuning) and a
# board profile header (capabilities/roles/defaults). tools/flash.py reads this,
# detects the connected board's serial, and flashes the matching firmware.
# Columns are TAB-separated. Lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# Get a board's serial:  pio device list   (USB "Serial Number" of the Teensy)
# esp32_env: the PlatformIO env for the box's companion ESP32 control MCU, in
# projects/t-dsp_esp32_bt_receiver ('-' = no ESP32 populated). flash.py does NOT
# flash the ESP32 (it's a separate MCU/project); this column just records which
# control build the box runs so it's reproducible. Flash the ESP32 separately:
# esp32dev = BLE control; esp32dev_wifi = WiFi LAN WebSocket control (tdsp.local:81,
# needs a .env with TDSP_WIFI_SSID/PASS next to that project's platformio.ini).

column5: local dev board (COM4), ESP32 NOT populated; Dexed MPE pool + OPLL drum voice, Bluetooth flagged out (header pins nobt)
